claims: American Express Platinum Member Airfares was formerly the International Airline Program.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares offers discounted premium cabin flights on over 30 participating international airlines.
Premium cabin includes First, Business, Premium Economy.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares includes select domestic economy fares.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares is valid for U.S. consumer/business Platinum members.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares requires booking via Amex Travel.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares supports up to 8 passengers per itinerary.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares allows earnings of both 5X Membership Rewards points and airline miles.
Participating airlines include Delta, United, Emirates, Qatar Airways, Singapore Airlines, Air France, and Lufthansa.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares benefits apply to the primary cardholder and up to 7 additional travelers.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares tickets must be booked through AmexTravel.com or by calling Platinum Travel Services.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares is eligible for refundable, restricted, and non-refundable fares.
American Express Platinum Member Airfares allows payment with Membership Rewards points.
Business Platinum members receive a 35% points rebate for payments with Membership Rewards points.
$200 Airline Fee Credit allows selecting one airline for up to $200 in annual statement credits on incidental fees including baggage and seat selection.
5X Membership Rewards points are earned on flights booked directly with airlines or via Amex Travel up to $500,000 per year.
The user must be traveling on the itinerary to use this benefit.
